senses.definition: n.m. (dialectic variation of כַּעַס, only in Jb);—כ׳ Jb 17:7, כָּ֑עָשׂ Jb 5:2; sf. כַּעְשִׂי Jb 6:2; כַּעַשְׂךָ Jb 10:17;—
vexation, grief of men Jb 5:2 (cf. Pr 12:16; 27:3), 6:2; 17:7.
vexation, anger, of God; c. כַּעַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִי Jb 10:17 thine anger with me.
